rests_on.token: assumption (A1, reading B): the token form, s* = max_x x(k - u(x))/a and x0 from u_in, u capped at Delta for a block reading the update code
rests_on.reduction: assumption (R): each block holding a step's token work passes one partial gradient at its passed width (partial_cut_bits), and the step's token work fills at least ceil(N w / c) blocks; blocks split by layers or tensors rather than tokens break it (one holding only frozen layers passes no partial)
rests_on.update: assumption (U): where two or more blocks hold a step's token work, the block applying the update to a coordinate reads its share of the gradient's cut (grad_cut_bits); the weights are read once, theta free; blocks split by tensors break it (a tensor's gradient made and applied in one block)
rests_on.decoding: assumption (D): a block reading the update code runs the whole decoder, so it holds at most c - d affected gates; any other block at most alpha_max (x0 s + s*) on the uncapped profiles
rests_on.fit: Fit's construction (te_core.formalism): every block reads Δ and its tokens' ids, and runs the decoder
rests_on.none: nothing: no kind's term exceeds 1 and Fit fails (the row's fit_fails), so rho >= 1 is all the menu gives

reading_a.label: assumption (A1, reading A): the default packer's blocks (formalism.packer), a block reading the update code at c gates
